crossRefs.note: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart…
He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it…
and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things…
for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and…
“Their feet are swift to shed blood.
